name: Organic Farmer's Market
description: Head to the city's largest park for the Feira de Produtores Biológicos, where you can buy high-quality organic produce, artisanal bread, and honey directly from local farmers.
longDescription:
The Feira de Produtores Biológicos is an organic farmer's market held at Parque da Cidade. This market provides a direct retail channel for local farmers to sell their certified organic produce, baked goods, and other agricultural products to the public. It aims to support sustainable farming practices and offer consumers access to fresh, locally sourced items.

Visitors can expect an outdoor market setting within Porto's largest urban park. The atmosphere is generally relaxed, with stalls displaying a variety of seasonal fruits, vegetables, and specialty items like artisanal bread and honey. The market caters to residents and visitors interested in organic food and supporting local agriculture.

Entry to the market is free. Parque da Cidade is accessible by public transport; the nearest metro station is Matosinhos Sul (Blue Line), approximately a 15-minute walk from the park's main entrances. Several bus lines also serve the park. The event is family-friendly.
